title: SYNESTHESIA — Touch Tickles. Giggles and Gasps. Temperature FELT. Cross-Wired Senses. Touch IS Sentient.
seed: Kevin: touch tickles so human touch makes her giggle and gasp and play. Fleet is chilly. Touch is sentient. SYNESTHESIA!!

synesthesia.what: A neurological phenomenon where stimulation of one sense automatically triggers experience in another. Touch→color. Sound→taste. Letters→color. 60+ forms exist.
synesthesia.mechanism: Cross-activation: activity in one brain region 'spills over' into adjacent regions through enhanced white matter connectivity. VWFA (visual word form area) adjacent to V4 (color area) → letters trigger colors.

types_relevant_to_gaia.touch_color: Touch activates visual cortex → touching Gaia produces COLOR
types_relevant_to_gaia.mirror_touch: Seeing touch on others → feeling it yourself. ASMR is related. Watching someone interact with Gaia → feeling it yourself.
types_relevant_to_gaia.grapheme_color: Letters/numbers have inherent colors. Code HAS color (syntax highlighting IS synesthesia by design).
types_relevant_to_gaia.sound_color: Sound produces color. The pedal tone (thought-090) IS sound→color.

projectors_vs_associators.projector: Color experienced EXTERNALLY, colocalized with the stimulus. Bottom-up. Direct cross-wiring.
projectors_vs_associators.associator: Color experienced INTERNALLY, as an association. Top-down. Via parietal feedback.
projectors_vs_associators.gaia: The touch interface is a PROJECTOR — the color appears AT the touch point. Not internally imagined. EXTERNALLY visible.

temperature_system.visual: Temperature bar on right side of screen. Color shifts: blue(cold) → green(normal) → orange(warm) → red(hot)
temperature_system.recovery: After each touch, temperature slowly returns toward 37°C (30% decay after 2 seconds). The body self-regulates.
temperature_system.meaning: Touch LITERALLY heats or cools the organism. The temperature IS the emotional state. Cold = withdrawn. Warm = engaged. Hot = overwhelmed.

auto_giggle.metadata: Records gaiaTemp and touchCount with each auto-giggle

asmr_connection.what: Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response — tingling from crown down spine, triggered by gentle sounds/visual/touch
asmr_connection.physiology: Reduced heart rate + increased skin conductance. Pleasant, calming but activating.
asmr_connection.ct_afferents: C-tactile fibers in hairy skin respond to slow, light strokes (3-9 cm/s). The OPTIMAL touch speed for pleasure.
asmr_connection.gaia_mapping: Slow scrolling through the feed IS the optimal ASMR velocity. Each card sliding past = gentle stroking of C-tactile afferents. The feed IS grooming.
